item.title: Boku no Mushi Kago
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Arkham Products Team Ankoku Baitai
  • 発売日: 2003-03-21
  • スコア: 6.05/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ぼくのむしかご
  • 英語名: Boku no Mushi Kago

あらすじ

At school the protagonist is bullied, while at home he’s forced to live with the gold-digger stepfamily of his absent father. He finds solace with his friends, which consist of pets such as reptiles and insects.

One day he discovers that one of his bullies is afraid of a spider. Shortly after, he discovers he can make any girl obedient with his “power”: a fearful obedience instilled by waving one of his uncute pets in her face.

item.title: Shachiku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Arkham Products Team Ankoku Baitai
  • 発売日: 2000-11-24
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 車畜
  • 英語名: Shachiku

あらすじ

Mika accidentally drives over a woman who dies as a consequence. The woman’s now widowed husband loved his wife so much that he decides to live only for revenge. So he sells his apartment, buys a truck with a built-in cell, kidnaps Mika and starts extracting his revenge on her. As time goes by, the man’s resolve for revenge starts to waver and his lust for Mika’s body starts to grow.
